Name: Custom NPC Thurstan - English
Author: HydrangeaGardenTea
Description:
This is an English translation of the Custom NPC mod created by [url=https://kym2020.tumblr.com/]KYM2020[/url], who was given permission by the original mod author to translate it and then they gave me permission to upload their translation. The original mod by Mihibi shuki is over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12462]here[/url]. Though, this mod is now based off the unofficial update by muxuelaiyin [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28358]here[/url] (who has graciously given me permission to update the translation based off their update).

If you have a more accurate translation of this mod or if there's any grammar or spelling mistakes or any bugs, please mention them.

[u][b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[/u][list=1]
[*]Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28358]required mod[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod
[*]Overwrite the required mod with this mod (it should result in [b][NPC]Thurstan/i18n/default.json[/b])
[/list][b][u]A brief introduction (that I copied and pasted from the original mod page)
[/u][/b][i]Thurstan claims to be a traveler who came to Stardew Valley accidentally. After meeting you for the first time, he will take a bus to town every day. His life background is unknown. It seems that he is very taboo to talk about his past. However, after his popularity gradually increases, he will reveal his heart to you
Go and be his only "best friend", he is waiting for you.[/i]

[b][u]Events[/u][/b]
0 ❤： After four days of gameplay, come to the mountain where Robin's house is located at 13:00-17:00 on any day other than Tuesday on Spring
2 ❤： From 17:00-20:00 on Monday or Tuesday, go to Cindersap Forest.
4 ❤： Except on Sundays, got to Cindersap Forest from 15:00 to 18:30 on rainy days.
6 ❤： Come to the beach at 8:00-14:00 on a sunny day on Tuesday, Thursday or Saturday.
8 ❤：
① Come to the forest under the farm at 21:00-24:00 on Sunday evening. (Thurstan will temporarily leave Stardew Valley) 
② After watching the event ①, go to the bus stop at 16:00-18:00 on Sunday afternoon.

[u][b]Gift Preferences[/b][/u]
Love: Fire Quartz, Cranberry Sauce, Mead, Kyanite, Bruschetta, Life Elixir
Like: All Artisan Goods, All Flowers, Fried Calamari, Spicy Eel, Eggplant Parmesan, Blackberry
Dislike: Catfish, Carp Surprise, Field Snack, Rabbit's Foot
Hate: All Trash, Weeds, Pepper Poppers, Red Mushroom, Pale Broth
Neutral: All Vegetables, Tom Kha Soup, Stir Fry

[b][u]FAQS
[/u]WHY DOESN'T HE SHOW UP IN MY GAME?
[/b]He won't show up in the game right away, you have to see his intro/0-heart event and then he shows up the next day at the bus stop.
Note: He's placed at a placeholder custom location, Custom_DayEnd_WarpRoom, you might have to wait a few minutes to see him at the bus stop or at the valley.

[b]WHY IS HIS PORTRAIT NOT WORKING?
[/b]You have to copy and paste his portrait to a subfolder Portraiture's portraits folder just like how you do with every Portraiture mod. Or you can use the Scale Up 2 patch that I uploaded in the files.

[b]IS THIS MOD COMPATIBLE WITH MOBILE?
[/b]No, the 1.6 update is not compatible with mobile. 
Also, mobile modding is almost dead right now and will be dead once the mobile version is updated to 1.6 unless someone decides to pick it up. 

I've also archived the old versions (which would most likely work with it) because it was... not good to say the least. 
Admittedly, I did a terrible job proofreading it. I overhauled nearly the entirety of it because I was unhappy with it.

[b]IS THIS COMPATIBLE WITH SVE?
[/b]I haven't played with SVE, but the mod author of the unofficial patch mentioned that this mod is now compatible with SVE.

[b]CAN I MAKE A TRANSLATION BASED OFF THIS TRANSLATION?/CAN I EDIT THE JSON FILES?[/b]
I wasn't the one who did the translation, I only did most of the proofreading and some of the more technical things (in the now hidden old versions that is).[i] Not to mention, it's generally a bad idea to base a machine translation off a machine translation, so [b]please don't base off a translation off of this translation[/b][/i]. Though, I guess that a personal edit wouldn't hurt anyone.

[b]WHAT MODS ARE YOU USING IN THAT SCREENSHOT?
[/b]- Project Yellog (the old version of it)
- Stardew Valley Reimagined 2
Farmer  (most, if not all of them, should be in blogs)
﻿- Clothes: ByeolChris's Cloak, one of Delotti's skirts
﻿- Hair: one of kkunma_09's
﻿- Body: GH's Peach Body
﻿- Accessory: GH's eyes highlight
UI
﻿- Overgrown Flowery Interface
﻿- Script Font
﻿- fish's bowknot cursors
- Natural Color - Reshade
